aml_transaction_risk_note: Offline Elliptic Random Forest model requires the full 165 graph/local feature vector. Raw on-chain transactions cannot be directly scored without running the full Elliptic topological feature extraction pipeline. Behavioral AML scores are kept strictly distinct from verified exchange entity identity.
disclaimer: All exchange attributions are derived strictly from verified external disclosures (GraphSense service disclosures and EtherScamDB). No exchange identities or fraud linkages were synthetically assumed or inferred from transaction risk classes.
